title: Session replay
description: Records what happens on the panel screens so a report can be played back.
masking: Every text on the screen is masked before it is sent, and so is every input value. A recording shows what was done, never what was written.
offHint: Session replay is off, so nothing is recorded.

switch.label: Record panel sessions
switch.hint: Off by default. It covers every account, and each account still has to agree.

consent.given: You agreed to be recorded on {{at}}.
consent.missing: You have not agreed to be recorded.

forget.confirm: Every recording of your own sessions is deleted. This cannot be undone.

errors.load: The setting could not be read
errors.save: The setting could not be saved
